name: IT Support
responsibilities: Owns employee laptops, desktops, keyboards, printers, peripherals and local software installation or configuration. Handles faults isolated to an employee device or peripheral. Shared networks and servers belong to Infrastructure; shared business application defects belong to Business Applications; centralized sign-in, permissions and security incidents belong to Security & Access. Select IT Support as affected only when the ticket explicitly describes disruption to its support work.

name: Infrastructure
responsibilities: Owns shared networks, Wi-Fi, connectivity, DNS, switches, server hosts and shared infrastructure availability. Restores connectivity and host availability when the ticket supports an infrastructure fault. Does not own business application code, centralized authentication policy or business records. Select Infrastructure as affected only when its infrastructure work is explicitly disrupted.

name: Business Applications
responsibilities: Owns shared business application defects, configuration, integrations and software workflows, including payroll, billing and dispatch applications. Investigates errors within a business application even when the technical cause is not yet known. Does not own employee peripherals, shared network or server faults, centralized sign-in, or Finance and Operations business decisions. An application being mentioned or made unavailable by another known cause does not alone establish application-maintenance work.

name: Security & Access
responsibilities: Owns centralized identity and sign-in services, single sign-on, MFA, account provisioning, permissions, access policy and suspected security incidents. Investigates authentication failures and security alerts without assuming an unconfirmed cause. Does not own ordinary application workflow errors, network availability or payroll records. Select Security & Access as affected only when the ticket explicitly disrupts its security or access work.

name: Finance
responsibilities: Owns payroll processing, reimbursements, invoices, billing, payments and financial records review or correction. Coordinates business work when the ticket explicitly blocks or affects one of these financial processes. Does not maintain application code, networks, servers or identity services. A reporter belonging to Finance or a payroll application being mentioned does not alone prove Finance has work or impact on the current issue.

name: Operations
responsibilities: Owns dispatch approvals, operational scheduling, customer delivery and day-to-day service delivery workflows. Coordinates operational work when the ticket explicitly blocks or affects these processes. Does not maintain application code, networks, employee devices or identity services. General workplace impact or a reporter's team membership does not alone prove an Operations impact.

name: HR
responsibilities: Owns employee records, onboarding administration, leave policies and balances, and employee process decisions. Corrects employee administration records when the ticket supports that work. Finance owns payroll amounts, reimbursements and financial records; Business Applications owns shared application defects; Security & Access owns central accounts, sign-in and permissions. Select HR as affected only when its employee-administration work is explicitly disrupted.

name: Procurement
responsibilities: Owns sourcing, purchasing approvals, supplier purchase orders, quote review and replacement purchase coordination. IT Support diagnoses employee device and peripheral faults; Finance owns invoice and payment records and payment processing. A supplier or invoice being mentioned does not alone establish purchasing work. Select Procurement only when current purchasing work or explicit disruption to it is supported.

name: Facilities
responsibilities: Owns premises maintenance, HVAC, lighting, building services and building electrical faults. Infrastructure owns network and server equipment. A switch losing power alone supports equipment investigation, not a confirmed building electrical fault. Select Facilities for supported premises work or explicit disruption to that work, not merely because a technical incident occurs in an office.

name: Legal & Compliance
responsibilities: Owns contract interpretation and review, regulatory obligations, and explicitly requested legal or compliance assessment. Security & Access owns security investigation and access policy; suspected security activity alone does not establish legal work. Procurement owns sourcing and purchase approvals. Select Legal & Compliance when current contract, legal, regulatory or compliance work is explicitly supported.

name: Customer Support
responsibilities: Owns external customer inquiries, customer case handling, service-policy answers and customer communications. Operations owns dispatch, scheduling and service delivery. Delivery disruption alone does not prove disruption to customer-support work. Business Applications owns shared customer-case application defects. Select Customer Support as affected only when its inquiry, case-handling or communication work is explicitly disrupted.

name: Data & Analytics
responsibilities: Owns analytical datasets, reporting definitions, join and aggregation logic, and analytical data quality. Business Applications owns operational application defects, including save and export failures; Finance owns correction of financial source records. A report, CSV or export being mentioned does not alone establish analytics work. Select Data & Analytics for supported analytical work or explicit disruption to that work.
